_comment: Transcribed from an in-game screenshot taken 2026-08-01 (Steam capture index 101 in the 16:03 run). Gadget screens carry a name, a model designation and a description but no stat block or trait chips, so this item has no stats or ratings. Art is cropped from the same shot. The page leads with the model designation because that is what EA's patch notes use.
name: RPG-7V2

description.text: A launcher that fires impact-triggered unguided rockets. Delivers effective damage against structures and vehicles. Inflicts greater damage on the sides, top, and rear of vehicles where the armor is thinner.

_unlock_note: Unlock recorded 2026-08-02 from Battlefield 6's own in-game unlock and challenge data. Not from the screenshot cited above: unlock text only displays in-game on items the account does not own.
